notes: Two body families in one file: gen 'k5' = full-size Jimmy (twin of the K5 Blazer, 1970-1991; K-Jimmy 1983-86, V-Jimmy 1987-91); gen 's15' = compact S-15 Jimmy / Jimmy 1983-1994 incl. 1992-93 Typhoon; gen 'gmt330' = 1995-2005 Jimmy.
Source rule: all GM/GMC material = one source (GM); Wikipedia articles together = one; EPA one; Flory one; Consumer Guide one. NHRA has no Jimmy rows.
HP gross 1970-1971, SAE net from 1972. hp is null where no GMC-specific rating was found or sources conflict.

GMC-only engines: none found in the Jimmy. The GMC V6 family (305/351) never appears in any Jimmy engine table (1970 GMC 4WD brochure lists only the Chevrolet-built 250/307/350); GMC brochures from 1979 state the engines are built by Chevrolet. The 292 six (pickups) is withheld for 1970-71.
Full-size Jimmy offered in 2WD (CS/CE) 1971-1982; 4WD only from 1983.
Flory citations come from Google Books search snippets of the GMC chapter powertrain charts (Jimmy columns); availability columns are not fully legible in snippets.
